headings.title: Three-year terms and staggered initial terms
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note. Establishes three-year terms with staggered two-, three-, and four-year terms for original members.

headings.title: Appointment by curators and nomination process
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and history note. Directs appointment by curators from task-force nominations while the task force exists, shifting nominations to the advisory board thereafter.

headings.title: Dismissal of advisory board members
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4 and history note. Permits dismissal of advisory board members by an affirmative two-thirds vote of the members.

headings.title: Expense reimbursement under sections 172.800 to 172.807
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 5 and history note. Provides curator reimbursement for actual expenses of advisory board and peer review committee members serving under sections 172.800 to 172.807.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived version 172.805:8740, all five subsections including subdivisions (1)-(7) of subsection 1, and L. 1987 S.B. 200 § 4 note; verified sourceUrl, sourceSha256, textSha256, and all five bodySha256 fingerprints. Retained all five drafted titles.

headings.title: Transfer of state cancer center property by agreement
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history/effective note (L. 1990 H.B. 1725 merged with S.B. 737; Effective 11-1-90). Permits transfer of real, personal, and mixed cancer-center property by agreement between the state cancer commission and curators, empowering the governor to convey governor-titled land.

headings.title: Transfer and use of unexpended appropriations
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and notes. Transfers control of unexpended cancer-center appropriations to curators for expenditure on the center's behalf in accordance with those appropriations.

headings.title: Authority to accept gifts and grants for cancer center
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and notes. Authorizes curators to accept gifts, grants, or other property transfers of any sort on behalf of the state cancer center.

Checked agreement-based transfer of state cancer center property and gubernatorial conveyance authority (1), transfer of control over unexpended appropriations (2), and authority to accept gifts, grants, or property transfers for the center (3). headings.title: Transfer of cancer center employees, leave, and benefit elections
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history/effective note (L. 1990 H.B. 1725 merged with S.B. 737; Effective 11-1-90). Covers agreement-triggered employee transfer on November 1, 1990, university personnel/leave rules, ninety-day written election to retain state benefits (defaulting to university benefits), good-health-evidence exemption conditions, and retirement service credit.

headings.title: Reimbursement of curators and MOSERS actuarial formula
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and notes. Provides reimbursement to curators for benefit-transfer liabilities and sets the ratio-based MOSERS pension-trust actuarial-value transfer formula.

Retained both drafted titles.

headings.title: Transfer and sale authority for rehabilitation center property
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history/effective note (L. 1996 S.B. 540; Effective 4-1-96). Permits transfer of DHSS Missouri rehabilitation center property by agreement, empowers gubernatorial conveyance of governor-titled land, and authorizes curators to sell transferred land with proceeds used consistent with section 172.850.

headings.title: Transfer of unexpended appropriations and lab exception
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and notes. Transfers control of unexpended rehabilitation-center appropriations to curators, excepting portions retained by DHSS for the tuberculosis testing laboratory.

headings.title: Transfer of trust, endowment, and other center funds
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and notes. Permits transfer of unexpended trust, endowment, pledge, special, and general funds unless prohibited by law, subject to agreed tuberculosis-laboratory reservations and expenditure consistent with section 172.850.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently read complete archived version 172.852:8750, all three subsections, and L. 1996 S.B. 540 (Effective 4-1-96) notes; verified sourceUrl, sourceSha256, textSha256, and all three bodySha256 fingerprints. Checked agreement-based transfer of DHSS rehabilitation center property, gubernatorial conveyance power, and curator sale authority consistent with 172.850 (1), transfer of unexpended appropriations excepting DHSS tuberculosis-testing-laboratory funds (2), and permissive transfer of trust, endowment, pledge, special, and general funds subject to law and TB-lab reservations (3). Retained all three drafted titles.

headings.title: Transfer of rehabilitation center employees and benefit elections
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history/effective note (L. 1996 S.B. 540; Effective 4-1-96). Covers agreement-triggered transfer of rehabilitation-center employees (excluding DHSS-reserved tuberculosis-laboratory staff), leave credit, ninety-day written election to remain in state benefits (defaulting to university benefits), good-health-evidence conditions, and retirement service credit.

headings.title: Reimbursement of curators and MOSERS actuarial formula
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and notes. Requires reimbursement of curators for benefit-transfer liabilities and specifies the MOSERS actuarial-accrued-liability ratio formula for transferred retirement service.

headings.title: Separate organ transplant assistance program and guidelines
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 1 and history note (L. 2001 H.B. 821, A.L. 2014 H.B. 1299 Revision). Directs the Missouri kidney program to administer a separate assistance program for immunosuppressive pharmaceuticals and other services for other organ transplant patients, with guidelines and eligibility similar to renal-disease patients.

headings.title: Administrative costs paid by new program participants
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 2 and history note. Requires new participants receiving assistance under this section to pay administrative costs associated with their participation.

headings.title: Coordination with family support and MO HealthNet divisions
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 3 and history note. Directs coordination between the Missouri kidney program and DSS's family support and MO HealthNet divisions for efficient, cost-effective assistance.

headings.title: Priority for pharmaceutical services and other available funds
headings.reviewNote: Read complete text of subsection 4 and history note. Establishes pharmaceutical services as the priority use of appropriated funds, while permitting other organ-transplant treatment services if other program funds are available.
